terra.problem: “Ritual,” “unclean,” and “sanctuary” may be difficult for a 10-year-old. Explain that this was a special religious cleansing that made someone clean according to God’s law and able to worship again. Use “they” rather than “he,” since several cards refer to a woman.
“The stain of sin” may sound like a physical mark. Use simpler wording to explain that purification can mean being cleansed from sin and its guilt.
